snippet.title: Nightmares: The Adventures (Flash) - Walkthrough Episode 1 - Broken Bone's Complaint
snippet.description:
A.K.A. Victor's Nightmares on various websites and YouTube.

Includes the full first episode by Sarbakan, recorded with Elgato HD60 using BlueMaxima's Flashpoint, without commentary.

If you enjoyed watching this video, please leave a like and subscribe! I would very much appreciate it!

Nightmares: The Adventures / Victor's Nightmares (Flash): https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYwqV0N4djf958mKn7tPUm3zk_1BBDVVb
